landing.heroLede: Build a client estimate in a few minutes right from your phone. Send a link — the client reviews and signs online.
landing.heroNote: First projects — free, no card required
landing.problemTitle: Estimates on a scrap of paper — a thing of the past
landing.problemSubtitle: A notebook, notes on your phone, a verbal “it'll be around seventeen grand” — that's lost money and arguments with the client.
landing.bad1: You count in a notebook or in your head, and forget things
landing.bad2: The client says “you added that” — and you can't prove otherwise
landing.bad3: You redo the estimate by hand for every project
landing.bad4: It looks unserious — the client hesitates
landing.good1: Add works from your catalog — the total adds up itself
landing.good2: The client signs online — a signed estimate can't be quietly changed
landing.good3: Save your works and prices — the next estimate takes a minute
landing.good4: A clean PDF with your logo — the client sees a professional
landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need. Nothing you don't.
landing.featuresSubtitle: Not a suite for design firms — a tool for the tradesperson who works with their hands.
landing.feature1Text: Client, project and works in one simple flow. No complex menus or extra fields.
landing.feature2Title: Your own catalog of works and prices
landing.feature2Text: Enter your rates once — then add them to an estimate in two taps. A starter set for your trade is already inside.
landing.feature3Text: The client installs nothing and signs up for nothing. Open the link, review the estimate, sign.
landing.feature4Text: A tidy document with your logo and contacts. Print it or send it — it looks solid.
landing.stepsTitle: Three steps from request to signature
landing.step1Text: Add a project and works from your catalog. The total adds up automatically.
landing.step2Text: Share a link or PDF. The client opens it from any phone.
landing.step3Text: The client signs online — the project goes into work and the estimate is locked in.
landing.finalTitle: Your first estimate — in a few minutes
landing.finalText: Free for your first projects. No card, no commitment. Create an account and get straight to work.
